claims: A fuse protects household appliances by breaking the electrical circuit during a short circuit.
It contains a thin wire that melts when excessive current flows through it.
This melting action stops the flow of electricity and prevents electrical fires.

claims.text: A fuse melts when a short circuit forms due to a damaged live wire contacting a metal case connected to ground.
A fuse acts as an automatic means of removing power from a faulty system during conditions like short circuits.
